comment: Shared by src/Root.tsx and still.test.mjs. Trigger lists replace the triggers of core/fixtures/ffi-seek.config.json; probes are DOM markers pinned to the bottom-right corner (offsets in px from the right edge), revealed when the named Simulation method runs (loaded: when useBrightFX returns a simulation; boundsArgs: when setBounds runs, its colour then replaced by the width and height it was given, as red and green, with blue lit when both are in 0..255; the placeholder colour here means shown but never written).
